records.claim: From 1 June 2026, a Swedish work permit generally requires employment conditions meeting the applicable rules, including a salary of at least 90 percent of Sweden's median salary under the new work-permit salary requirement.
records.methodology: Direct review of current Swedish Migration Agency work-permit guidance

records.claim: Eligible graduates with a Swedish higher-education qualification can apply for a residence permit to look for work or explore starting a business after completing qualifying studies, subject to the applicable conditions and maintenance requirement.
records.methodology: Direct review of current Swedish Migration Agency post-study guidance
